service_name.description: The name of the service for which this configuration is generated.

executable.description: The path to the executable to be run under NUMA policy.

exec_args.description: List of command-line arguments to pass to the executable.

preferred_node.description: Preferred node for memory allocation. Maps to --preferred.

interleave_nodes.description: Nodes for interleave policy. Maps to --interleave.

weighted_interleave_nodes.description: Nodes for weighted interleave policy. Maps to --weighted-interleave.

balancing.description: Enable kernel NUMA balancing. Maps to --balancing.

strict.description: Error on conflicting page policy. Maps to --strict.

huge_pages.description: Use huge pages for SYSV shared memory. Maps to --huge.

touch.description: Touch pages to enforce policy early. Maps to --touch.

shm_file.description: Path to tmpfs/hugetlbfs file for persistent policy. Maps to --file.

shm_id.description: Numeric shared memory ID. Maps to --shmid.

shm_keyfile.description: Key file for shared memory ID generation via ftok. Maps to --shm.

shm_length.description: Length of shared memory region to apply policy to. Maps to --length.

shm_offset.description: Offset into shared memory segment. Maps to --offset.

shm_mode.description: Mode for creating shared memory segment. Maps to --shmmode.

use_all.description: Unset default cpuset awareness. Maps to --all.

separator_cmd.description: Insert '--' before command to separate numactl options. Maps to --.
